item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We know what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must stop it from being built.

2. We reject the idea that building superintelligence is inevitable. If it is built within the next 20 years, the resulting catastrophe will kill at least a billion people. We demand a ban—not a race to disaster.

3. We cannot protect humanity while racing to build the technology that will destroy it. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe killing at least a billion people. We work to prevent that future.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable price for technological progress. Our task is not to help companies win the race to superintelligence. Our task is to stop that race. We work toward a ban because preventing this catastrophe requires preventing the technology that causes it. We can choose a future in which humanity survives and flourishes, but we must act before that choice is taken from us. We will keep making that case—and organising for action.
